name: gaspol-video
description: End-to-end AI video production: brainstorm → script → image prompts (NB2) → video prompts (VEO 3.1 / Seedance 2.0 / Kling 3.0) → post-production. Routes information-heavy scenes to coded Remotion shots instead of a video model that cannot render legible text, generates voice-over with a per-character voice, assembles with ffmpeg under an A/V duration gate, and mixes domain-aware SFX, burned subtitles and a music bed into a finished file.
